There were two teams of magnificent horses hooked up to a road grader as a lone Amish man bellowed out commands.

It was amazing to watch other teams of horses skillfully maneuvered into place with so many hands helping and guiding the entire operation. There were Fathers and their sons along with grandsons all dressed alike, all working for the common good, all smiling, chatting and following directions. Freedom from government's heavy hand, freedom from surveillance, freedom to work as a family and a community. Freedom from the internet and the sickening shows on cable.
